newsitem.title: UK: Hanson up, recovers from profit-taking bout.
newsitem.headline: Hanson up, recovers from profit-taking bout.

text.p: Shares in British building materials group Hanson Plc rose 10 pence to 314, recovering from Thursday's sudden 24-1/2 pence drop which came in spite of the release of favourable first-half earnings.
"The figures were good and after the fall yesterday they were due for a bounce," said a dealer.
Hanson, the rump of the former conglomerate which went through a major demerger process in the past year, reported pre-tax profits of 47.8 million stg.
By 0915 GMT, over 2.15 million shares had changed hands.
